## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the small smooth cup down on the light gray coaster.

Task description: Move the small blue smooth-sided open cup on the right side of the head-camera view to the light-gray round coaster to its left, then release it.

Success criteria: Place the small cup on the light gray coaster, with sufficiently close horizontal positions and its bottom lowered to and supported by the coaster surface. Both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Part of the small cup is at the right edge of the image. Use a live view to confirm the full rim and clearance outside it, avoiding contact with an unseen part of the cup wall.
- Consider an unobstructed wall section near the cup rim, with one finger inside and the other outside, gripping below the rim with the pads. Match the opening to wall thickness and internal space to reduce slipping caused by gripping only the rim.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on the inside and outside of the cup wall, rather than mistaking image overlap for having enclosed it. A small test lift can check whether the grip slips on the smooth cup wall.
- Keep the cup opening upward and its bottom off the table during transport. Make necessary pose adjustments in an open area to reduce the risk of the bottom scraping the table or the cup body brushing nearby objects.
- Lower gradually during placement, watching the gap between the outer finger and coaster. Open the gripper only after the cup base is supported, avoiding release while suspended or tipping it during withdrawal.
